requirements.requirement: Recover exact definitions of sets, y, m, c_fila and row membership, not reconstruct them from final CSV multipliers. The missing f3_eval dependency prevents claiming faithful original execution.

Bind source snapshots/models/cached rates, target canonical periods, calendar versus rounded exposure and the complete ultimate-to-observed bridge. Identify source/climate/history availability at quote dates; historical actual future weather is not prospective evidence.

Protect all target learning in each outer group scope: C0, levels, NCB/prior factors, residual FAC, shape and level ratios. A pooled production object cannot validate its own training groups. Persist exact ancestors and membership before controls.
Identify all constants previously selected with public outcomes. Preserve their origin and freeze them separately; no public calibration or new probes to make a historical comparison pass.
Specify whether the intended object is a delivery representation, complete faithful reproduction or an explicitly different strict algorithm. Do not relabel A1S/S2/H1 or decoded outputs as F3c.

Before any new fit freeze configuration, finite cost, comparator, support and adverse criteria, grouped/conditional annual comparisons and whole-flow poison/replay controls. New-business cohorts from P19 must remain in the evaluation; no favorable-line selection.
Version the complete producer closure before future delivery, preserve Claude authorship of original recipes and distinguish Codex inspection or ports from independent professional validation.
